endpoints.description:
OPD / walk-in samples require the lab bill to be paid first (`LAB_PAYMENT_REQUIRED`) unless the
hospital disabled `lab_require_payment_before_sample`. IPD and Emergency are exempt.

The patient is identified as the sample is taken (MSDS AAC 3): scan the wristband (`wristband_code`;
`PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` when it is another patient's), or ask two identifiers (`identity_check`
TwoIdentifiers: the name and the date of birth or MRN), or for an emergency patient who cannot be identified yet
`EmergencyOverride` with a note. Nothing given: `PATIENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED`. Label the tube at the patient's side.
The sample cannot do that in its present state: `LAB_SAMPLE_STATE_INVALID`.

**Required permission:** `lab.sample.collect`

**Required permission:** `lab.sample.collect`

endpoints.summary: Verify (publish + notify doctor) or reject back to the bench
endpoints.description:
After a lost answer, never repeat the decision by itself: read `GET /lab/requisitions/{requisition_id}` (the
queue row's `requisition_id`) and find this `result_id` in its `results`. `Published` (with `verified_stamp`) or
`Rejected`: decided; still `PendingVerification`: not decided, offer it again.
Verified publishes the result: `lab.result.published` goes to the ordering doctor and the verifiers; a lab-only
walk-in has no ordering doctor, so it goes to the reception desk that registers walk-ins (the users holding both
`patient.create` and `lab.requisition.create`), who hand its report over.
The technician who entered a result cannot verify it (`LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER`). Verifying a critical result
(`has_critical_value`) opens it in the critical results log (`GET /critical-results`): tell the doctor now and
record it there (MSDS AAC 5). `delay_reason`: why a late result was late (MSDS AAC 4). A result already verified or
rejected: `LAB_RESULT_STATE_INVALID`.

**Required permission:** `lab.result.verify`

**Required permission:** `lab.result.verify`

acceptance_rules: Keep focus in a hidden scanner input; Enter triggers GET /lab/scan/{barcode}.

Collect: identify the patient first (body of POST /lab/samples/{id}/collect): scan the wristband (wristband_code; PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH = another patient's band: STOP), or ask two identifiers (identity_check TwoIdentifiers); an emergency patient who cannot be identified yet: EmergencyOverride with identity_note. Label the tube at the bedside (MSDS AAC 3).
Receiving a sample still Pending (taken at the lab counter now) needs the same identity body.
Flag values live (red/amber) against metric_grid[].reference_range and critical before submitting; a text metric with critical.values (e.g. Positive for a priority disease) is critical too (flag C).

Worklist: is_emergency first, due_at and is_overdue (red): the turnaround clock starts at the sample's receipt (MSDS AAC 4). is_send_out: the sample goes to a partner laboratory (screen lab_send_outs).

Reject an unusable sample (POST /lab/samples/{id}/reject: Haemolysed, Clotted, InsufficientVolume, WrongContainer, Unlabelled, Mislabelled, Leaked, DelayedTransport, Contaminated, Other + note): the test goes back to collection with a new barcode and the doctor is told.
Lab technicians never see prices or take cash; LAB_PAYMENT_REQUIRED means the patient must pay at the counter.

GET /lab/samples/{sample_id}/label is a print, never a preview: call it only when the user prints or reprints. Each call counts as one more label (label_print_count) whether or not the printer printed it; it never changes the sample (row_version stays), so nothing needs reloading before the next action.

Events: lab.result.pending_verification reaches every bench (lab.result.enter) when any technician submits a result: refresh the worklist. lab.result.published belongs to the verifiers and the doctor, not the bench.

Exists for the service laboratory (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id lab_bench (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.

acceptance_rules: You cannot verify results you entered (LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER).
Rejection requires a note.
Verify critical values first: after lab_critical_release_minutes the ordering doctor sees them marked Pending verification.
Verifying a critical result opens it in the critical results log: tell the doctor NOW and record it (screen critical_results_verifier).
A result past its due time: ask for delay_reason (optional) before verifying (MSDS AAC 4).
Verifying signs the result with your stamp (verified_stamp), printed on the lab report under the technician's (performed_stamp).

Each queue row carries its context: open its order with requisition_id (never by the patient's name), compare entered_by with the signed-in user's user_id to warn before LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER, and ask for the delay reason when is_overdue (due_at, the server's clock); never derive a deadline from entered_at.

After a lost verify answer, never repeat it by itself: read GET /lab/requisitions/{requisition_id} and find the result_id. Published or Rejected: decided; PendingVerification: offer it again. A row gone from the queue says neither.

Exists for the service laboratory or blood_center (work): show it as GET /establishment views.screens says for screen_id lab_verification (full; open_work: without its new work, with the banner "No new ... from now on"; records: history and corrections only; setup: only from Facility settings; hidden: in no menu), after login and again on establishment.changed. Never decide it from the profile's category.
